scope: Actual React HUD controls/runtime and nested-scroll reachability at original viewports; complete-card PNGs at the recorded taller same-width viewport; controlled HTTP fixture, no native/game validation
note: Condensed from the actual runner audit; preserves every checked target and result while omitting repetitive ancestor geometry and full fixture save payloads. Complete original audit is in the referenced artifact.
checks: Exactly three alarms, all nine metrics, safe metric changes, high/low triggers, keyboard drafts and rollback
Canonical C/bar/kmh/kW/Nm survive C/F, mph, PSI/kPa, hp/PS and lb-ft edits
Persisted reload, style round-trip, reset cancellation and confirmed defaults
